pages.observation: Title, date, review status, global hypotheses, weight definitions and profile inequalities are legible; no clipping or overlap.
Root-characterization statement, all three equivalence conditions, weak-derivative argument and strong-quotient setup are legible.
Bounded-multiplier proof, endpoint remark, inherited L1 recovery and start of conditional interpolation are legible; bottom equation is not clipped.
Rearrangement proof, independent potential estimate (P), envelope and complete compact-source extension hypotheses are legible.
Finite-moment and BV recoveries, coefficient distinction and three boundary regimes are legible.
Explicit critical marginal, endpoint distinctions, thresholds and complete attribution are legible; local small-font attribution avoids an orphan seventh page.

checks.limit: Finite exact regressions and numerical diagnostics are not proofs or formal verification.

reproducibility_scope: Exact source archive bytes are canonical. PDF byte reproducibility was established across two builds with the recorded installed toolchain; other TeX/Poppler versions can change bytes or pixels without changing the text.
